{{Short description|Norwegian physicist}}
'''Arnljot Elgsæter''' (born 19 March 1944 in [[Kistrand]]) is a Norwegian physicist.

He is now a [[professor emeritus]] who held a tenured position at the Department of Physics at the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] (NTH) / [[Norwegian University of Science and Technology]] (NTNU) from 1974 to 2009. While at NTNU, he served twice as department chair and once as [[dean (academic)|dean]].<ref>Asle Sudbø, "A glance at 2009", [http://www.ntnu.no/c/document_library/get_file?uuid=6f8128df-7179-4ecb-b790-4cc172e290c6&groupId=10422 Annual Report 2009], Department of Physics, NTNU, retrieved 2012-11-16.</ref> He holds a master of technology in Engineering physics from NTH in 1969, and received a [[Ph.D.]] in [[biophysics]] from [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1971, under the supervision of Daniel Branton.<ref>[http://dssmhi1.fas.harvard.edu/emuseumdev/code/emuseum.asp?action=advsearch&newsearch=1&profile=people&rawsearch=constituentid/,/is/,/7599/,/false/,/true&style=single&searchdesc=Prof.%20Arnljot%20Elgsaeter People: Prof. Arnljot Elgsaeter]{{dead link|date=October 2016 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}, Waywiser, [[Harvard University]] Department of the History of Science, retrieved 2012-11-16.</ref>

Arnljot Elgsæter is a member of the [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]]<ref>[http://www.dknvs.no/akademimedlemmer/medlemmer/gruppe-v-biokjemi-biofysikk-og-molekylaer-biologi/ Gruppe V Biokjemi, biofysikk og molekylær biologi] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131221235336/http://www.dknvs.no/akademimedlemmer/medlemmer/gruppe-v-biokjemi-biofysikk-og-molekylaer-biologi/ |date=2013-12-21 }} Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters, retrieved 2012-11-26.</ref> and the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ntva.no/index.php?option=com_club&view=member&id=111%3Aelgsaeter-arnljot&Itemid=60|title=Medlemmer: ELGSÆTER, Arnljot|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=29 November 2012}}</ref>
